sentences.en: Fishermen and sailors sometimes claim to have seen monsters in the sea.
sentences.zh: 渔民和水手有时声称在海上看到过怪物。

sentences.en: Though people have often laughed at stories told by seamen,
sentences.zh: 虽然人们常嘲笑水手们讲的故事，

sentences.en: it is now known that many of these 'monsters' which have at times been sighted are simply strange fish.
sentences.zh: 现在人们知道，许多不时被人看见的“怪物”其实只是奇怪的鱼。

sentences.en: Occasionally, unusual creatures are washed to the shore, but they are rarely caught out at sea.
sentences.zh: 偶尔有些奇异的生物被冲到岸上，但在海上很少被捕获。

sentences.en: Some time ago, however, a peculiar fish was caught near Madagascar.
sentences.zh: 然而不久前，在马达加斯加附近捕获了一条奇特的鱼。

sentences.en: A small fishing boat was carried miles out to sea by the powerful fish as it pulled on the line.
sentences.zh: 这条力大无比的鱼拉扯着钓线，把一条小渔船拖到了几英里外的海面上。

sentences.en: Realizing that this was no ordinary fish, the fisherman made every effort not to damage it in any way.
sentences.zh: 渔民意识到这不是普通的鱼，就竭尽全力不使它受到任何损伤。

sentences.en: When it was eventually brought to shore, it was found to be over thirteen feet long.
sentences.zh: 最后把它弄上岸时，发现它有十三英尺多长。

sentences.en: It had a head like a horse big blue eyes, shining silver skin, and a bright red tail.
sentences.zh: 它有马一样的头、大大的蓝眼睛、闪亮的银色鱼皮和鲜红的尾巴。

sentences.en: The fish, which has since been set to a museum where it is being examined by a scientist, is called an oarfish.
sentences.zh: 这条鱼后来被送到博物馆，由一位科学家进行研究，它叫皇带鱼。

sentences.en: Such creatures have rarely been seen alive by man as they live at a depth of six hundred feet.
sentences.zh: 人们很少看到这类生物活着的样子，因为它们生活在六百英尺的深处。
